text:
marc: Heads-up — starting a small EU->US canary for runtime v3.2.1 + router v2.8. Console will be pinned to v1.14 for compatibility. Targeting 10% EU traffic to validate routing + kv-cache behavior. Deploy bot will start the canary now.

deploy-bot: canary started: id=canary-2267078901 runtime=v3.2.1 router=v2.8 scope=eu traffic=10% timestamp=2267078902

aline: noted. I'll watch runtime telemetry. Rollback criteria: p50 > 300ms for 5m OR error rate > 2% sustained for 3m.

rick: Router patch deployed for shim-handshake flags. I'll watch 5xx rate and route failures. If we see shim timeouts I'll rip traffic back to US-only.

jessica: Console pinned to v1.14 in the release config. That version includes the runtime client fix for session tokens. If we need to revert, we'll pin back to v1.13.

marc: Rollback control: primary is `/rollback canary canary-2267078901 force`. Deploy-bot also accepts a tag `rollback=true` via the UI. Fallback plan is immediate traffic shift to us: 100% -> us.

priya: Oncall here — I'll take action if deploy-bot posts `canary_health: fail` OR if SLO paging > 4 alerts. Ping @priya in thread to escalate.

sam: Adding release note pointer: PR#4923 (runtime), PR#1980 (router). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4923

aline: Quick canary traffic config I'm applying now: ```yaml
canary:
  id: canary-2267078901
  traffic:
    eu: 10
    us: 90
  health_checks:
    latency_p50_ms: 300
    error_rate_pct: 2
```

rick: Router helm patch applied: `router.image=router:v2.8-canary-2267` and `route.shimHandshake=true`. Watching logs for handshake failures.

deploy-bot: health: checks passing — cpu: 45%, p50: 120ms, errors: 0.1%, canary_id=canary-2267078901 timestamp=2267079024

marc: Okay to proceed to broader rollout if no objections. Hold final promote in console for 10 minutes (hold-until 15:04 UTC). If anyone sees red, call it out immediately and @priya will act. :thumbsup:

priya: Acknowledged, monitoring metrics and logs.

jessica: I'll monitor console UI flows and post screenshots if any render/regression shows up.

deploy-bot: canary ended: result=pass health=green promote_window=10m canary_id=canary-2267078901 timestamp=2267079660

marc: If no rollbacks in 10m I will run `/promote canary-2267078901` to shift to 100%. Announcing promote at +10.

sam: Confirmed no DB migrations or schema changes in these PRs. Safe from that perspective.

marc: Final note for changelog: "runtime: v3.2.1 (latency optimizations, kv-cache fix); router: v2.8 (shim-handshake fixes); console pinned v1.14 during rollout". Will post release notes after promote.
